events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_full $6.61 (model confidence 0.93)
events.body:
This is a driver-cancelled no-show dispute, so it enters the policy through NS-0: cancelled_by = driver and the driver asserts the rider was a no-show [F3][F12][NS-0]. The fee at stake is the $6.61 cancellation fee on record [F3][F7].

NS-1 requires all three of (i) "I'm Here" pressed, (ii) GPS placing the driver at the pickup point at the moment of the tap, and (iii) more than 3 minutes waited inside the pickup radius. Requirement (i) is met — a tap at 22:37:10 [F5][NS-1]. Requirement (ii) fails: at the tap the driver was 1000 m from the pickup, and his closest approach during the whole episode was 868 m, never within 200 m [F1][F5][NS-1]. Requirement (iii) also fails: he spent 0 s inside the pickup radius after the tap, and his 5 min 5 s stationary period was at 993 m from the pickup [F2][F5][NS-1]. The platform itself never recorded an arrival (driver_arrived_at null) [F4]. The GPS and timeline records conflict with the driver's chat/statement claims of being present, and system records prevail [F9][F11][F12].

Because NS-1 (i)(ii)(iii) is not satisfied in full, NS-2 applies: the $6.61 cancellation fee must be refunded in full to the rider [F3][F7][NS-2]. NS-2 additionally attaches an account flag where the driver tapped "I'm Here" while GPS shows he was not at the pickup point (tl-here present and within_200m false) — which is exactly this case [F5][F1][NS-2], and the driver's profile shows 2 prior upheld no-show disputes in 90 days [F17], so the flag is warranted.

On the rider's side there is no countervailing fact: the rider stayed at the pickup and queried the driver's position [F10], and the rider's profile shows 0 upheld disputes in 90 days [F16], though profile facts cannot decide the case on their own. Traffic and weather records provide no reasonable-cause support for the detour/absence narrative [F13][F14][F15].

events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: We reviewed your dispute and the $6.61 cancellation fee will be refunded to you in full as a Ryde voucher. Two things decided it: the driver tapped "I'm Here" while GPS showed him about 1,000 metres from your pickup point, and he never came within the pickup area — the platform never logged him as arrived. You'll also see your account is in good standing. Nothing further is needed from you.

DRIVER: We reviewed the no-show cancellation you reported. The $6.61 cancellation fee is being refunded to the rider, because the GPS record shows you tapped "I'm Here" around 1,000 metres from the pickup point and never entered the pickup area. Your account is being sent to Ryde review over the arrival tap, and it will also be flagged. Keep in mind that repeated upheld no-show disputes on your account count against you, so please only tap arrival when you're actually at the pickup point.
